bio_md:
# 宋钦宗 · 主要事迹

赵桓为[[n-song-hui|徽宗]]长子，宣和七年（1125）金兵南下之际受内禅，改元靖康。

靖康元年（1126）金兵围汴，李纲力主守城，坚拒和议，然旋为宰执所排而罢；城中主战、主和反复，勤王之师亦因指挥不定而坐失战机。同年闰十一月金军破汴，靖康二年（1127）金人掳二帝及宗室北去，北宋亡；张邦昌受金人之命僭立伪楚，旋为众人所废。

钦宗北迁后被封为天水郡公，绍兴三十一年（1161）崩于金地。其弟康王[[s-song-gao|赵构]]即位于南京应天府，南宋始。

bio_parts_en.value:
, received the abdication in 1125 as Jin armies advanced, and changed the era to Jingkang.

In 1126 the Jin besieged Kaifeng. Li Gang organized the defense and rejected peace terms, but was soon sidelined by the chancellors; the court veered between war and peace, and relief armies lost their chance through indecision. In the eleventh month the city fell. In 1127 the Jin carried off both emperors with the imperial clan - the end of Northern Song. Zhang Bangchang's puppet regime lasted weeks before collapsing.

Qinzong was taken north, enfeoffed Duke of Tianshui, and died in Jin lands in 1161. His younger brother Kang Wang
was enthroned at Yingtian, beginning the Southern Song.
